newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek short rates stay firm on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Greek short rates stay firm on tight liquidity.

text.p: Short term money rates stayed firm in late trade with most of Monday's dealing action in overnight and tomorrow/next funds, which were up 30-40 basis points on tighter liquidity, dealers said. Activity on the forex front was thin.

"Liquidity was squeezed by pension payment ouflows and it is likely to get tighter on Tuesday as funds leave the system. The central bank could come out on the offer side at a likely 13.40 percent in the overnight," a money dealer said.
Forex forwards were firmer following the upside move in the short end of the rate spectrum.

The Bank of Greece kept its 12.40 percent overnight intervention bid but o/n funds traded higher around 12.80-12.90 percent. The one-month Athibor interbank offer rate firmed to 13.07 percent on Monday.
Dealers were awaiting the finance ministry's plans regarding a possible auction of government securities and renewal of maturing T-bills on December 18.
The mark was quoted at 157.97/02 drachmas from Monday's 157.665 fix, the dollar at 245.22/32 drachmas from 245.100 and the Ecu at 304.00/05 from 304.630 drachmas.
"Forex trade was dull as Greece mves to the tune of quiet European markets," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
